FN-XLBRZ7E-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 196
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Margie Wilcox
Government
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/10/2025
House Bill 196 as introduced could increase the obligations of a county commission by an
undetermined amount dependent on the cost to supervise and administer the county's juvenile
detention center as provided by this bill.
In addition, this could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Supreme Court to
review and revise the Rules of Juvenile Procedure to comply the provisions of this bill.
Page 1
